I am 59 years old and I have farmed these 20 mu in Quzhou for 35 years. I finished primary school and then went straight to the fields. I farm alone — just me in the household — so I hire machinery for plowing and harvesting, but I do the spraying and fertilizing myself.

It is spring now. My wheat is already in the ground from last October. I planted 14 mu with improved wheat seed. I will topdress it with urea at green-up and irrigate three times total with my well: after green-up, at jointing, and at grain filling. I put about 28 kg of nitrogen per mu in total, counting the compound fertilizer I applied at sowing last autumn. Phosphorus is 10 kg per mu, potassium 8 kg. I will spray pesticide twice — once for aphids, once for rust. I rotary-tilled before sowing last autumn. Last year I got 520 kg per mu, and I expect 520 kg again this year if the weather holds.

After I harvest the wheat in early June, I will plant 14 mu of hybrid maize on the same land, no-tillage. I will put 25 kg nitrogen per mu, 8 kg phosphorus, 8 kg potassium — half at sowing, half at the big trumpet stage. Three irrigations: after sowing, at jointing, and at filling. Two pesticide sprays. I expect 580 kg per mu.

I will plant 6 mu of cotton in April with improved seed. Cotton needs more potassium or the bolls don't open, so I use 15 kg potassium per mu, 20 kg nitrogen, 10 kg phosphorus. Four irrigations in summer when it gets dry. Five pesticide sprays because the bollworm always comes. I will rotary till in April. I expect 280 kg of seed cotton per mu.

I think about costs every day. Fertilizer prices went up again. But I dare not cut back. Last year Old Wang from the east village tried to save 50 yuan per mu on urea and his wheat turned yellow. I would rather spend too much than too little. A bad harvest is a disaster; wasting some fertilizer is just money spent. I watch what my neighbors do. Around here, everyone applies about the same to wheat. If I try something new and it fails, I lose my whole year's work. So I do what I did last year, maybe adjust a little if the seed dealer tells me something, but only if my neighbor tried it first and it worked.
